*.rationale: Unmounting filesystems can disrupt system stability; -a unmounts all filesystems, -f bypasses safety checks, and incorrect use could render the system inaccessible.

version: umount from util-linux 2.39.3 (libmount 2.39.3: selinux, smack, btrfs, verity, namespaces, idmapping, statx, assert, debug)
